dedupe_keys.name: net load profile for a 10 mwh hydrogen storage system

description: Francesco Demetrio Minuto at Politecnico di Torino publishes 102 synthetic net-load profiles for hydrogen storage. The free Zenodo Excel workbook uses CC BY 4.0. Hourly power values in watts represent charging when positive and discharging when negative. Services differ in discharge duration and annual cycle count, with ten megawatt-hours supplied to storage per cycle and an assumed round-trip efficiency of 0.4. These profiles can compare storage dispatch and capacity requirements across service definitions. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this collection. Coverage is simulated annual service profiles, not measured operation at a hydrogen plant. Fixed efficiency excludes part-load behaviour, degradation and technology-specific conversion dynamics. Calendar details and the implementation of constraints require checking in the workbook. No profiles were downloaded or energy balances independently verified.
